What does PG-free mean? Patriarca Gucci (PG) is a Ragdoll female far back in many pedigrees, whose lines have been linked to a hereditary form of dwarfism when she appears on both sides of a cat's pedigree. "PG-free" means Patriarca Gucci doesn't appear in the checked generations of the pedigree. It's a pedigree check, not a DNA test, since no widely available DNA test for this exists yet.
